requirements.evidence_summary_en: Permanent base, seasonal components and test pieces across D0/D1/D2 allow R&D, maintenance and ordinary access to coexist; accessibility, drainage, fire and human service remain when AI is removed.

requirements.evidence_summary_en: The 43.6 km² scale studies how weather, transport, landscape, sanitation, rail, universities, firms and communities form winter innovation capacity; submission geometry is a concept carrier, not the official research polygon.

requirements.evidence_summary_en: The 11.4 km² scale provides a five-state base, six operation maps, five candidate routes, eight nodes and three service conditions, separating concept topology, reproducible submission geometry and unknown statutory controls.

requirements.evidence_summary_en: Each provisional key area has a spatial prototype, envelope, operations node, AI/industry test, landmark, dependencies and stop actions. Each also registers pre-site-fit plan/section relationships, unresolved dimension domains, missing data and next outputs without presenting coarse polygons/diagrams as true scaled engineering alignments.

Zhongzhiyuan tests materials/equipment, the Origin Community buildings/shared use and Dazhongsi station operations, without replacing statutory land use.

requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 按“门厅先改、首层再用、院落先试、新建最后”组织低扰动更新，W1—W8与三阶段均有前置和停止条件；FAR/总建面保持unknown，不伪造拆建清单。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Low-impact renewal follows vestibule first, ground-floor reuse, courtyard testing before new build; W1–W8 and three phases have prerequisites/stops. FAR and floor area stay unknown and no false demolition list is created.

requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 无障碍、排水和消防连续线先于设备扫掠、储雪、骑行和装卸；洁净/盐雪/雨水/清洗水分流，站口换乘叠合风雪、带水、回冻和疏散。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Accessible, drainage and fire-continuity lines precede equipment sweep, storage, cycling and loading. Clean/salt snow, rain and washwater are separated, while station interchange overlays wind/snow, tracked water, refreeze and egress.

requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 活力不是活动数量，而是公园在干冷、降雪和回冻时仍可达、可停留、可维护；遗产绿廊案例只借分段开放和生态连续机制，不移植图形与运营。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Vitality means the park remains accessible, inhabitable and maintainable under dry cold, snow and refreeze, not more events. Heritage-corridor cases contribute phased access/ecological continuity only.

requirements.evidence_summary_en: Character comes from low winter sun, permeable wind/snow elements, low-glare light, clear edges and railway engineering culture of survey–grade–drainage–maintenance, not decorative railway symbols or bright screens.

Each provides a pre-site-fit plan/section prototype and next-stage 1:500/1:100–1:200 deliverable; no true scaled fitted drawing or building-specific action exists.

requirements.title_zh: 众智园AI自主创新加速区
requirements.title_en: Zhongzhiyuan AI Autonomous-Innovation Accelerator
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
visual_sections: 三区重点设计 / Three Key Areas
冬作总览 / Winter Works Overview
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 众智园以W4/W5组成材料—设备—维护体系；场地套合前原型先解既有硬地、物流/公众路径、消防和洁净/污染水路，再解设备扫掠、样架、维修与雪储位。V1卡以同设备/人工流程作对照并规定接管、急停和退出，低温机器人不声称首创。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Zhongzhiyuan uses W4/W5 for a materials–equipment–maintenance system. Its pre-fit prototype first resolves hardstand, logistics/public paths, fire and clean/contaminated water, then swept paths, samples, repair and snow storage. V1 compares the same device/human process and defines takeover, emergency stop and exit; cold robots are not claimed as original.

requirements.title_zh: 北京AI原点社区
requirements.title_en: Beijing AI Origin Community
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
visual_sections: 三区重点设计 / Three Key Areas
冬作概念场景 / Winter Works Concept Render
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 原点以W6/W7形成室内外梯度；原型先解南向首层、疏散、文保、树影和开放时段，再解门斗/座位/截水尺寸域。2小时冬阳待冬夏联合校核；V2预测维护只有预注册评价卡，无模型/数据/结果，固定巡检和原厂报警不断。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: AI Origin uses W6/W7 for an indoor–outdoor gradient. The prototype first resolves south-facing ground floors, egress, heritage, tree shade and hours, then vestibule/seating/interception domains. The 2 h target awaits winter/summer review. V2 is only a preregistered evaluation card—no model/data/result—and scheduled inspection/onboard alarms continue.

requirements.title_zh: 大钟寺AI产业聚集区
requirements.title_en: Dazhongsi AI Industry Cluster
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施

visual_sections: 三区重点设计 / Three Key Areas
雪先清优先链 / First-Cleared Accessible Routes
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 大钟寺原型先解真实站口、客流/疏散、清雪扫掠和排水，再解挡雪—候车—截水—干燥关系；没有真实断面或未批连廊。V3卡以同节点同事件的固定巡查为对照，评价漏报/误报/提前量/漂移/无效出勤，人工复核后才处置。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Dazhongsi first resolves real entrances, flows/egress, clearance swept paths and drainage, then snow screening–waiting–interception–drying; there is no real section or unapproved link. V3 uses same-node/same-event patrol control, evaluates misses/false alerts/lead time/drift/unnecessary callouts, and permits action only after human confirmation.

requirements.evidence_summary_en: The full stack is problem definition–environment/material baseline–enclosed validation–human comparison–limited service–published failure–spring repair. Six cases support research/firm/talent/scenario links without transferred figures.

requirements.title_zh: AI+场景赋能新范式与智能化AI活力城市设计
requirements.title_en: AI+ scenario paradigm and intelligent active-city design

visual_sections: 雪先清优先链 / First-Cleared Accessible Routes
冬季服务等级与证据链 / Winter Service and Evidence
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 十四场景覆盖四类冬季工况；AI仅占V1—V3三项。三张评价卡声明当前无模型/场地数据/结果，并逐项定义输入、人工/规则对照、建议输出、人工确认、误报漏报/提前量/漂移/无效工单或出勤、停止和非AI退出。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Fourteen scenarios cover four winter conditions; AI appears only in V1–V3. The cards state there is no model/site data/result and define inputs, human/rule controls, advisory output, human confirmation, false/missed alerts, lead time, drift, unnecessary work/callouts, stopping and non-AI exit.

requirements.title_zh: AI公共空间、智能原生新业态与朝圣地标设计
requirements.title_en: AI public space, AI-native activity and pilgrimage landmarks
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
visual_sections: 三区重点设计 / Three Key Areas
冬作概念场景 / Winter Works Concept Render
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 冻融尺、冬阳席、雪晴厅是低技术公共学习/服务构件；智能原生业态是可维修材料、低温设备、建筑能耗与预测维护的受控验证。V2只输出待人工确认的检查建议，固定巡检、人工问询和非数字基本服务不因模型停用而中断。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The Freeze–Thaw Gauge, Winter Sun Commons and Snow-Clear Hall are low-tech public learning/service elements. AI-native activity is controlled validation of repairable materials, cold equipment, building energy and predictive maintenance. V2 only suggests inspections for human confirmation; scheduled inspection, staffed information and nondigital basic service continue after model exit.

requirements.title_zh: 百年京张文化、中关村文化与AI新文化融合叙事设计
requirements.title_en: Integrated Jing-Zhang, Zhongguancun and AI culture narrative
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
风险、版权与合规说明
visual_sections: 冬作总览 / Winter Works Overview
三区重点设计 / Three Key Areas
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 百年铁路文化以测量、坡度、桥隧、排水、维护和时刻的工程方法连接中关村测试/开源文化；AI新文化公开失败、修复和人工贡献，不把未鉴定构件写成遗存。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Railway culture is expressed through survey, grade, structures, drainage, maintenance and time, linked to Zhongguancun testing/open-source culture. AI culture publishes failures, repair and human contribution without inventing relics.

requirements.title_zh: 一带全球AI创新活动体系与长期运营设计
requirements.title_en: Global AI activity system and long-term operations
report_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
visual_sections: 六层冬作底图 / Six-Layer Winter Atlas
冬季服务等级与证据链 / Winter Service and Evidence
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 年度节奏为雪前排演、首场雪“第一条路”、融雪期回冻夜查和春季冻融修复周；它是公开作业与证据复盘，不是节庆。三阶段实施与每项目停止条件支撑长期运营。
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The annual rhythm is pre-snow rehearsal, first-snow 'first route', melt-period refreeze night check and spring freeze-thaw repair week. It is public operations/evidence review rather than a festival, backed by three phases and project stop conditions.
